sections.heading: 1. Pace the project
lines: ① Work in 30–45 min blocks, then switch.
② Alternate lifting with lighter jobs.
③ Kneel or use a low stool for ground work.
④ Keep loads close; get a hand for bulky ones.

sections.heading: 2. Get medical help if…

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Lulu spent the whole weekend on garden beds and flat-packs before the Christmas guests arrive. Monday morning, the back is grumbling.

Hours of bending and carrying you don't usually do is a sudden jump in load, and that's a common reason for a Monday strain. Most settle over days to a couple of weeks with gentle movement.

Next time, work in 30 to 45 minute blocks, alternate heavy jobs with lighter ones, kneel for ground-level work and get a hand with bulky items. Leg numbness or weakness, or bladder or bowel changes, need your GP or ED.
